title: Beyond Benchmarks: Can Small Open-Weight Models Get Real Coding Work Done?
abstract: arXiv:2610.34241v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Making an open-weight language model generate text is not the same as making it finish coding work. This retrospective empirical systems experience report follows my engineering work from July to October 2026 across coding clients, model-specific serving recipes, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and MLX. Models behind a nominally compatible endpoint still differed in tool-call formatting, turn control, context behavior, cache reuse, and reliability. A served model, coherent text, executed tool calls, and code that passes independent behavioral checks proved to be distinct levels of progress. The evidence includes 4,165 coding-agent gateway turns from my own sessions, 623 debug jobs, and three separate delegation studies with hidden behavioral checks and a fixed Claude Opus 5.5 parent. translated_title: 超越基准测试：小型开放权重模型能否完成真正的编码工作？
translated_abstract: 让开放权重语言模型生成文本并不等于让它完成编码工作。本报告是一份回顾性的实证系统工程经验报告，记录了作者从2026年7月到10月在编码客户端、模型特定服务配置、vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp和MLX方面的工程实践。研究发现，名义上兼容的API端点背后的模型在工具调用格式、回合控制、上下文行为、缓存复用和可靠性方面仍存在显著差异。模型被成功部署、生成连贯文本、能执行工具调用、以及代码通过独立行为检查，被证明是四个不同层次的进展阶段。证据包括来自作者自己会话的4,165次编码代理网关交互、623个调试任务，以及三项带有隐藏行为检查并使用固定的Claude Opus 5.5作为父代理的独立委托研究。保存的冷前缀请求的中位首字时间（time to first token）约为69.4秒，而高复用请求仅为2.8秒（观察性数据）。在一项45次试验的研究中，直接codi……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该实证经验报告基于4,165次真实编码代理会话、623个调试任务和三项委托研究，指出小型开放权重模型能否完成真实编码工作取决于工具调用格式、缓存复用等系统层面的工程细节，而非基准测试成绩。
en_tdlr: This retrospective empirical systems report, based on 4,165 real coding-agent turns and multiple delegation studies, shows that whether small open-weight models can get real coding work done depends on systems-level engineering details like tool-call formatting and cache reuse rather than benchmark scores.
